author: Midnightstorm
body:
I think that prestiges should be added back in. I just achieved prestige 2 on Nebula this morning, which was a pretty awesome feeling after being prestige 1 for the longest time. When I saw that Avicus no longer had prestige levels, I got a little angry. I partly bought the Emerald rank so I could level up faster, because I'm a slightly impatient person.

Also, I think the new blood effects will further increase lag for users.

Overall, I am not generally happy about this update :(
